mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This relationship is consistently observed across multiple economic cycles.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20d S&P 500 returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5.0% signals a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, which generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE falls below 5.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand, driving corporate revenue growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between joint HOUST/RSAFS signal and 20d S&P 500 returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In low-interest-rate regimes (FEDFUNDS < 2.5%), a lower federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In low-interest-rate regimes (FEDFUNDS < 2.5%), Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20d S&P 500 returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between INDPRO and 20d S&P 500 returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.3 percentage points over three months signals economic deterioration, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces the cost of capital for firms and encourages risk-taking in equity markets, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 5d S&P 500 returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 950.0 thousand units signals weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST falls below 950.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
